description: This file defines a Flask route for a health check endpoint using Flask-Smorest. It creates a Blueprint and a class-based view that returns a simple 'Healthy' message to signal the application's health status.

classes.name: HealthCheck
classes.description: A Flask MethodView that handles GET requests to perform a health check and returns a JSON message indicating the server is healthy.

methods.name: get(self)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the health endpoint, returning a JSON object with a health status message.

ctags.name: blp
ctags.pattern: /^blp = Blueprint("Health Check", "health", url_prefix="\/", description="Health check route")$/

fields.name: blp = Blueprint("Health Check", "health", url_prefix="\/", description="Health check route")
